description:
The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation invites you to submit a quote for RFQ CORHQ-26-Q-0422 for Owndata subscription maintenance. We request offerors to utilize the Price Schedule to fill in your pricing for all line items needed. Terms and Conditions, EULA, or MSAs must be sent with your quote to be incorporated in the subsequent contract award, the FDIC prefers Government approved terms. See section M of the RFQ for Evaluation Criteria.     

 Each submission should have these components (preferably separated): 

 
	 Price Schedule or Quote – Vendors must complete the attached pricing schedule, or the proposal will be rejected. 
	 Section K of the RFQ – Representation and Certifications 
	 EULA or MSAs Or Warranty Terms – Any terms and conditions 
	 Pre-Award SCRM Information (if applicable) 
	 Letter of Authorization from manufacturer 
	  Proposed GSA Schedule Contract or NASA SEWP Contract (If Applicable)  
 

 Questions are due by  12:00PM EST on   November 17, 2026 . All quotes are due by  12:00PM EST on November 30, 2026.
